# Pulsin Network

> Pulsin Network is a network of independent hubs (physical spaces such as co-livings, makerspaces, hacker houses and regenerative villages) around the world. Hubs share what they know, test what works and back each other up, so no one has to carry the weight of running a physical space alone.

What the network does together:

- Hub Support: community calls, one-on-one consulting, grant support and introductions to rooms a hub could not reach alone.
- Plural Events: the same topic on the same day in different cities.
- Residencies: pilgrims travel to a hub with a specific mission and contribute their skills; hubs host pilgrims to move a project forward.
- Magazine: what was built, how, and what we would rethink, published on Substack.

The network is for hubs that put the money back into society, keep what they build open for others, and share the wins and the mess so the next hub starts ahead.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pulsin.network/): what Pulsin Network is, areas of action and how to become part of it
- [About](https://pulsin.network/about.html): how the network shows up for a hub, the core team and the hubs in the constellation
- [Hubs](https://pulsin.network/hubs.html): every hub in the network, what a hub is and whether your hub is a fit
- [Residencies](https://pulsin.network/residencies.html): how the residency program works for pilgrims and host hubs, in six steps
- [Manifesto](https://pulsin.network/manifesto.html): why we choose to inter-depend as a network of hubs

## Hubs in the network

- [Akasha Hub](https://akasha.barcelona/en/): Barcelona, Spain
- [Commons Hub Reichenau](https://www.commons-hub.at/): Reichenau an der Rax, Austria
- [Commons Hub Brussels](https://commonshub.brussels/): Brussels, Belgium
- [Liminal Village](https://liminalvillage.com/): Ascoli Piceno, Italy
- [Urbe Hub](https://hub.urbe.build/): Rome, Italy
- [The Giveth House](https://giveth.house/): Barcelona, Spain
- [El Pantano](https://www.elpantano.org/): Tigre, Argentina
- [Traditional Dream Factory](https://www.traditionaldreamfactory.com/): Odemira, Portugal
